A [[Color/Legends|crimson-bladed]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] was wielded by the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Apprentice]], [[Darth Venamis]].<ref name="DP" />

==History==
===Construction===
Darth Venamis presumably constructed the lightsaber during his time as apprentice to [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]].<ref name="DP" />

===Duel with Darth Plagueis===
Having used one of Tenebrous's ships to get onto [[Sojourn (moon)|Sojourn]], Venamis tripped a sensor before allowing his presence to be briefly sensed by [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]]. Eventually luring the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] out, he confronted him and they engaged in a high paced lightsaber duel. Tenebrous had made sure to train Venamis in Plagueis's style of combat, allowing Venamis to predict and counter all of Plagueis's attacks. Venamis had great finesse with his lightsaber, displaying great precision and accuracy, even searing Plagueis's neck. He'd toss his lightsaber from hand to hand in the battle alongside twirling his body and switching forms. He at one point lept onto a overhanging [[Tree/Legends|branch]], and when Plagueis went to destroy it with a [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force blow]], Venamis simply stayed [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Flight|suspended in mid air]]. Eventually, Plagueis started to sacrifice his offensive attacks for a more defensive style, allowing Venamis to lose his precision and accuracy in the fight as he fought more desperately to win. Eventually, at the height of Venamis's attack, Plagueis performed a two-handed swing from between his legs, cutting into the Bith's chest, and opening a wound up to his chin, though the strike failed to cut into Venamis's lung. Plagueis then crashed his lightsaber down, disarming Venamis of his blade. Venamis attempted to retrieve his lightsaber with the [[The Force/Legends|Force]], but Plagueis was faster and summoned the blade before Venamis could. In a last ditch effort, Venamis attempted to summon in a barrage of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force Lightning]], however, Venamis didn't get chance to unleash it before Plagueis crossed the two crimson blades around his neck and caused him to yield. Venamis accepted that Plagueis was better than him and that he must apprentice himself to Plagueis. Plagueis denied the pledge, knowing he'd always have to watch his back around Venamis. Plagueis disengaged both [[Darth Plagueis's lightsaber|his]] and Venamis's lightsabers, clipping them to his belt and then giving Venamis a [[Coma-bloom/Legends|plant]] that would poison him.<ref name="DP" />

What happened to Venamis's lightsaber after the duel is unknown.<ref name="DP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Venamis's lightsaber first appeared in the [[2012]] novel, [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']].<ref name="DP" />
